edits.current:
Sum of every element in the Devengados block. Item 6 and item 8 of the art. 5 mandatory content. Input [4] to the CUNE, where it must be TRUNCATED to two decimals - truncated, not rounded, a distinction that catches many implementations. Bidirectional set with 'Rounding residual' (NIE186), which is present only where round-half-to-even rounding of the individual concepts leaves this total differing from the sum of its parts.

Source: the total is the sum of the elements reported. Payroll groups wage types as 'Entitlements', 'Deductions' and 'Non Cash Earnings/Deductions': include all 'Entitlements' wage types mapped to Devengados elements, plus only those informative 'Non Cash' earnings explicitly mapped (NIE193 / NIE154); employer contributions and bases in the Non Cash grouping are never included. A wage type that is in the gross but in no element, or in an element but not in the total, is a mapping error. A negative earning line (for example the reversal WTs 62216, 62540) is netted against the positive lines of the same concept in the month, inside that concept's element, since no element accepts a negative value (Population Rules, amount format); the concept a reversal wage type belongs to comes from its WTC attribute.

edits.current:
Money value of the solidarity sub-account (0.50% of the base). Reported separately from the subsistence amount and from FondoPension; the two FSP sub-accounts are never summed in the XML.

Source: WT 2553 'Solidarity Pension Fund' holds the total FSP (solidarity + subsistence) in one wage type. The engine splits it: solidarity amount = 0.50% of the contribution base (WT 64990); subsistence amount = the rest (0.50% from 4 SMMLV plus the band increment from 16 SMMLV). The two amounts must add back to WT 2553. Where WT 2553 includes amounts computed on a base other than the month's (arrears), the add-back check applies a base check or a tolerance.

edits.current:
Employee health contribution rate: 4.00% of the contribution base (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204, as amended by Ley 1122 de 2007 art. 10). The employer's 8.5% is NOT an employee deduction and must never appear here.

A working old-age pensioner (worker sub-type 01) still contributes to health: 4.00% on the salary (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 157; Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 2.2.1.1.2.1 - the base of a worker under a labour contract is the monthly salary; where the affiliate receives salary or pension from two or more employers, the contributions are made in proportion to the salary or pension received from each, paragraph of the same article). Only the pension contribution is 0.00 for sub-type 01 (NIE164): the obligation to contribute to pension ceases once the affiliate meets the requirements for the old-age pension (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 17, as amended by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 4).

For a pensioner paid by the employer the base is the mesada pensional (Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 2.2.1.1.2.1) and, from 2024, the rate follows the pension band: 4% for a mesada of 1 SMLMV, 10% above 1 and up to 3 SMLMV, 12% above 3 SMLMV (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 par. 5, with the inciso added by Ley 2294 de 2023 art. 78; Resolución 1271 de 2023 art. 1); Porcentaje is the band rate and Deduccion the amount on the mesada.

For an apprentice without contribution, Salud and FondoPension are still emitted (1-1) with Porcentaje 0.00 and Deduccion 0.00.
edits.proposed:
Employee health contribution rate: 4.00% of the contribution base (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204, as amended by Ley 1122 de 2007 art. 10). The employer's 8.5% is NOT an employee deduction and must never appear here.

A working old-age pensioner (worker sub-type 01) still contributes to health: 4.00% on the salary (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 157; Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 2.2.1.1.2.1 - the base of a worker under a labour contract is the monthly salary; where the affiliate receives salary or pension from two or more employers, the contributions are made in proportion to the salary or pension received from each, paragraph of the same article). Only the pension contribution is 0.00 for sub-type 01 (NIE164): the obligation to contribute to pension ceases once the affiliate meets the requirements for the old-age pension (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 17, as amended by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 4).

For a pensioner paid by the employer the base is the mesada pensional (Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 2.2.1.1.2.1) and, from 2024, the rate follows the band of the TOTAL mesada of the pensioner - the sum of the shared mesadas, of the mesadas received in Colombia and abroad, or of the shares of all the beneficiaries of a survivor or substitute pension, the value reported in campo 63 of the pensioners' PILA (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.28, p. 64; CO-PILA-007): 4% for a total mesada of 1 SMLMV, 10% above 1 and up to 3 SMLMV, 12% above 3 SMLMV (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 par. 5, with the inciso added by Ley 2294 de 2023 art. 78; Resolución 1271 de 2023 art. 1); Porcentaje is the band rate and Deduccion the amount on the mesada.

For an apprentice without contribution, Salud and FondoPension are still emitted (1-1) with Porcentaje 0.00 and Deduccion 0.00.
edits.why: #23: band keyed on the total mesada (campo 63), as in CO-PILA-007 Population Rules C9.
edits.evidence: AT3 v15 §2.2.2.28 'Campo 63 – Valor total de mesada pensional: Corresponde a la sumatoria de los valores de las mesadas compartidas, a la sumatoria de las mesadas devengadas en Colombia y en el otro país pensionante o a la sumatoria total del valor que le corresponda a cada uno de los beneficiarios de la pensión de sobrevivencia o sustitución. Este valor será tenido en cuenta ... para seleccionar la tarifa a aplicar al Sistema General de Seguridad Social en Salud de acuerdo con ... el parágrafo 5 del artículo 204 de la Ley 100' (raw/docs/oficiais/CO/2026-10-21-MinSalud-Anexo-Tecnico-3-PILA-pensionados.pdf p. 64)

edits.current: Build the ET art. 388 depurated base: gross taxable payments, less the mandatory health, pension and solidarity-fund contributions (non-taxable income de renta), less the art. 387 deductions elected by the employee (dependants at 10% of gross capped at 32 UVT per month, prepaid health up to 16 UVT per month, housing-loan interest up to 100 UVT per month), less the 25% exempt income of art. 206 num. 10. Apply the two caps: deductions plus exempt income may not exceed 40% of gross less non-constitutive income, nor 1,340 UVT per year (the annual limit is apportioned at 111.6667 UVT per month, a configurable apportionment rule). Convert the resulting base to UVT at 52,374, read the art. 383 table, convert back to pesos, and approximate to the nearest 1,000 under ET art. 868. Under Procedure 2 apply instead the fixed percentage recomputed each June and December on the preceding twelve months divided by 13.
edits.proposed: Build the ET art. 388 depurated base: gross taxable payments, less the mandatory health, pension and solidarity-fund contributions (ingresos no constitutivos de renta), less the art. 387 deductions elected by the employee (dependants at 10% of gross capped at 32 UVT per month, prepaid health up to 16 UVT per month, housing-loan interest up to 100 UVT per month), less the 25% exempt income of art. 206 num. 10. Apply the two caps: deductions plus exempt income may not exceed 40% of gross less non-constitutive income, nor 1,340 UVT per year (the annual limit is apportioned at 111.6667 UVT per month, a configurable apportionment rule). Convert the resulting base to UVT at 52,374, read the art. 383 table, convert back to pesos, and approximate to the nearest 1,000 under ET art. 868. Under Procedure 2 apply instead the fixed percentage recomputed each June and December on the preceding twelve months divided by 13.

edits.evidence: ET term 'ingresos no constitutivos de renta'
